name: Plexpod Westport
description: Popular co-working space with multiple flexible meeting rooms. Community-friendly and frequently used for tech meetups.

name: Think Big Partners
description: Startup accelerator and co-working space that frequently opens its event space to the tech community.

name: Kansas City Public Library — Central Branch
description: The historic Central Library has community meeting rooms available to groups at no cost. Book well in advance.

name: Johnson County Community College
description: JCCC frequently hosts tech group meetings in its classrooms and event spaces. Great AV, free parking.

name: UMKC Volker Campus
description: University of Missouri–Kansas City makes classrooms and lecture halls available for community tech groups.

name: South KC Chamber of Commerce
description: Professional training and meeting facility in south KC with a large flexible room (up to 80) and a smaller boardroom. Hybrid-capable with smart boards and pro audio. Outside catering permitted.
address: 1300 E 94th Street, Suite 100, Kansas City, MO 64131

name: Mid-Continent Public Library (multiple branches)
description: MCPL's 40+ branches across Clay, Jackson, and Platte counties offer reservable meeting rooms for community groups. Larger Library Centers (Colbern Road, Green Hills, Woodneath) are best for bigger groups.

name: Lifted Logic Event Space
description: Free professional event space with a full auditorium, meeting rooms, and open workspace. Great AV, on-site coffee shop, ADA accessible, and hybrid/recording support.

name: KC Tech Central
description: Downtown KC's shared home for the innovation community, anchored by KC Digital Drive and KC Tech Council. Coworking, event space, and connections to founders and tech partners.

name: Kauffman Foundation Conference Center
description: Nationally recognized convening site with nine rooms up to 200 people. Free to use (catering costs apply) for 501(c)(3)s and government orgs aligned with education or entrepreneurship. Advance reservation required.

name: Johnson County Library (multiple branches)
description: JoCo Library's branches across Johnson County offer free meeting rooms for nonprofits, government agencies, and educational/community groups. Meetings must be open to the public. Reserve up to 3 months ahead.

name: Kansas City, Kansas Public Library
description: Wyandotte County's public library system offers free community meeting rooms. The Main Branch auditorium holds up to 55. Reserve by phone at least 48 hours ahead.

name: United Way of Greater Kansas City
description: Free event and meeting space for current or prospective United Way nonprofit partners. CommUNITY Space seats 48; smaller conference rooms also available. Weekdays 9–5 only; one month advance notice required.
address: 4801 Main Street, Suite 425, Kansas City, MO 64112

name: KU Edwards Campus Conference Center
description: University of Kansas's Overland Park campus welcomes community groups and businesses for training, professional development, and educational events. Rooms from 4 to 350 people. Contact for a quote.

name: Locally Grown KC
description: Coworking and event venue in the Crossroads with flexible space for up to 100 people. Good for meetings, workshops, and community gatherings.

name: Cerner Innovation Campus
description: Oracle Health (formerly Cerner) occasionally opens its campus event spaces to the tech community for larger events.
address: 2800 Rockcreek Pkwy, North Kansas City, MO 64117
